Australian Education Delegation Visits Pune to Boost India Ties

An Australian education delegation visited Pune to enhance partnerships between Australian and Indian educational institutions. The visit focused on understanding Indian students' aspirations, exploring academic collaborations and student pathways, and strengthening institutional ties. The delegation aimed to bolster the educational relationship between the two countries.
